svg.title: Four horizontal layers of a wooden shelter
svg.desc: An illustrative blueprint matching the static shelter scene: a floor, two wall layers and a roof, made from 79 oak planks. A two-block-high entrance is in the south wall. A one-block window is in the west wall. Dots are required air, not unspecified cells. No door item is used.

g.text: A shelter drawn layer by layer
5 × 5 × 4 · top-down views · north at the top · east to the right · bottom → top
